scope: A deterministic diagnostic assay on the two retrospectively selected v0.2 projective checkpoints. This run can localize failure modes but cannot support a confirmatory emergence claim.
question: After positive radial scale is quotiented out, do the learned recurrent operators preserve finite continuation packets under long composition, switched words, and repeated abstractly null loops?

formal_objects.semantic_chart: B^{-1} M_g B = P_g Lambda_g + E_g
formal_objects.positive_gauge: Lambda_g is positive and state dependent; it is not assumed to be one global scalar
formal_objects.finite_packet: States with the same decoded continuation outcomes for every word in a declared finite suffix bank
formal_objects.packet_margin: Minimum signed decoder margin over that finite suffix bank
formal_objects.interpretation: A finite task-relative packet is not an infinite quotient, a smooth semantic manifold, or an observer-independent meaning.

rules: The inherited seeds 0 and 1 are frozen and retrospectively selected.
Every model outcome is labeled developmental and posthoc.
Synthetic controls adjudicate assay validity; they do not count as evidence that the learned models satisfy the mechanism claim.
Scientific gate failure is retained as a result and does not make a completed run invalid.
Any change to this file or the evaluated source changes the source digest and requires a new run.

diagnostic_constants.packet_suffix_enumeration: exhaustive binary words from length 0 through packet_horizon
diagnostic_constants.positive_orientation: quotient only by strictly positive scale

assay_gates.A08_nonnormal_control: flagged with individual radii < 1 and projective gain > 30

learned_mechanism_reference_gates.M05_projective_domain_safety: minimum > 1e-8 and no undefined switched applications

capability_reference_gates.C01_structured_long_depth_accuracy: >= 0.70 per seed/family at final profile depth

claim_rule: A run is complete when execution succeeds and all assay gates pass. Learned mechanism and capability gates are reported separately and conjunctively. Their failure falsifies or narrows the corresponding claim; it does not erase earlier causal-execution evidence.
automatic_interpretation_failures: Treating positive radial scale as the only possible ambient defect
Treating statewise gauge improvement as proof that all residual error is gauge
Calling a finite-horizon packet an infinite semantic quotient
Substituting individual spectral radii for switched projective stability
Averaging over depth in a way that hides late packet erosion
Calling exact-chart control success spontaneous emergence
Making claims about pretrained language models, awareness, or consciousness from this finite assay

requirements: fresh training seeds and frozen thresholds
projective recurrence with no radial growth channel
comparison against terminal-only and conditioning-matched controls
